description: This file contains unit tests for the quic::QuicCryptoServerConfig class and related components, testing server configuration, certificate compression, source address tokens, and config management logic.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerConfigTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing QuicCryptoServerConfig functionalities.

classes.name: SourceAddressTokenTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for source address token behavior and validation.

classes.name: CryptoServerConfigsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for managing and testing server configuration protobufs and primary config selection.

classes.name: ValidateCallback
classes.description: A callback class for handling the result of client hello validation during tests.

methods.name: ServerConfig
methods.description: Test that the default server configuration includes AES-GCM and ChaCha20 cipher suites.

methods.name: CompressCerts
methods.description: Test compression of a certificate chain and cache size update.

methods.name: CompressSameCertsTwice
methods.description: Test that compressing the same certificate chain twice uses cache.

methods.name: CompressDifferentCerts
methods.description: Test that different but similar certificate chains are compressed separately and cache size increases.

methods.name: SourceAddressToken
methods.description: Test creation and validation of source address tokens for different IPs.

methods.name: SourceAddressTokenExpiration
methods.description: Test expiration and clock skew handling of source address tokens.

methods.name: SourceAddressTokenWithNetworkParams
methods.description: Test that cached network parameters are correctly written and read from source address tokens.

methods.name: SourceAddressTokenMultipleAddresses
methods.description: Test that a token can be valid for multiple IP addresses.

methods.name: NoConfigs
methods.description: Test behavior when no server configs are set.

methods.name: MakePrimaryFirst
methods.description: Test that the config with the earliest primary time becomes primary.

methods.name: MakePrimarySecond
methods.description: Test that the primary remains unchanged when a new config with later primary time is added.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Test removal of configs and primary config re-election.

methods.name: DeletePrimary
methods.description: Test deletion of the primary config and re-election.

methods.name: FailIfDeletingAllConfigs
methods.description: Test that deleting all configs is rejected.

methods.name: ChangePrimaryTime
methods.description: Test updating primary time and re-election logic.

methods.name: AllConfigsInThePast
methods.description: Test selection of the most recent config when all are in the past.

methods.name: AllConfigsInTheFuture
methods.description: Test selection of the earliest config when all are in the future.

methods.name: SortByPriority
methods.description: Test primary config selection based on priority when primary times are equal.

methods.name: AdvancePrimary
methods.description: Test primary config switching at correct times.

methods.name: AdvancePrimaryViaValidate
methods.description: Test primary config switching based on validation callback timing.
